description: For heavily compressed, blocky MPEG-2/H.264 footage with DCT macroblocking and chroma starvation.
use_case: Early 2000s web rips, 360p/480p DivX, low-bitrate digital archives

revert_compression.tooltip: Smooths DCT block boundaries. Above 85 wipes out fabric texture.

improve_detail.tooltip: Volatile in Iris; exceed 30 causes bright edge ringing.

sharpen.tooltip: Keep low on Iris; rely on Recover Original Detail instead.

reduce_noise.tooltip: Targets high-frequency luminance chatter. Over 50 creates waxy skin.

dehalo.tooltip: Strips over-sharpening halos baked into old transcodes.

recover_original_detail.tooltip: Blends original high-frequency luma back. Kills plastic look.

common_mistakes: Going above 2x in a single pass on degraded SD
expected_output: 720p or 1080p, reduced macroblocking, preserved fabric/foliage texture, no plastic skin
